store.name: Finality SMP
store.tagline: Welcome to the official Finality SMP store.
store.about:
Every purchase helps keep Finality SMP running. Ranks are a one-time payment and stay with you permanently, unless you choose the monthly option.

Purchases are delivered automatically, usually within a minute. If you are offline, they arrive the next time you join.

categories.name: Bundles
categories.description: The best value in the store. Everything inside costs a lot more on its own.

categories.name: Ranks
categories.description: Support the server and unlock perks. Spend $200 in total to unlock the exclusive Emerald rank, and $500 for Obsidian.

categories.name: Rank Upgrades
categories.description: Already have a rank? Only pay the difference.

categories.name: Cosmetics
